item.title:
Nicole Kidman is learning to be a death doula.

“As my mother was passing, she was lonely, and there was only so much the family could provide... I went, ‘I wish there was these people in the world that were there to sit impartially and just provide solace and care.’ So that’s part of my expansion and one of the things I will be learning."

https://t.co/BgUwES90PM
